remarks: Sunny and inviting one-bedroom end unit in the heart of Downtown Stamford, offering the perfect blend of modern updates and unbeatable convenience. This bright, airy home is filled with natural light and features hardwood floors, contemporary finishes, and a beautifully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, and ample storage. The updated bathroom and thoughtfully designed built-in closets add both style and functionality.  Enjoy the convenience of a designated parking space located directly next to the rear entrance, on-site laundry, and heat and hot water included in the rent. Located just over a mile from the Stamford train station and within walking distance of restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, and entertainment, this move-in-ready home offers comfortable, low-maintenance living in a prime downtown location.
